# Saved V2 identity witnesses

These 41 explicitly stamped configs and float64 grids/source measurements
were captured from immutable base `746c6b1ca6b8782d018d5b86b0f7c5e5cadca2bd`.
They are identity expectations, not ATH parity expectations. No coordinate
tolerance is allowed. JSON round trips must preserve the same version and
exact values. Five runtime comparisons additionally rebuild the base and
candidate in the same environment and compare mesh and normalized STEP bytes
using the existing shared identity harness and supported bare-mode dictionary
transport. The rollback mouth is not a valid infinite-baffle plane at the base.
An additional 153 scalar R-OSSE samples pin the original arithmetic association
for native, V1 and V2 inputs.

Coverage: OSSE and R-OSSE, body budgets 9/12/20/30/37, with/without extension,
and with/without rotation declarations. R-OSSE block rotation was ignored at
the base and stays ignored. Active top-level R-OSSE rotation did not exist at
the base; its old-stamp refusal is tested separately. The final case preserves
V2's unit Scale.Z no-op beside a nonunit global Scale.

Only a fresh import or an explicit `ath-2026-09a-v3` stamp selects the new ATH
sampling/transform/source rules. Loading a saved V2 file never upgrades it.
